properties.description:
crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_refused_host_is_told_which_flag_admits_it.rs, against the real binary, plus the host_gate unit tests (7).
· Single-design --http 127.0.0.1:0: a POST and a GET with Host team.example.org get 403, text/plain, a body naming "team.example.org", localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1 and `--http-allow-host team.example.org`, and exactly one stderr line naming the fix across both requests. Loopback is still answered with 200.
· --http-allow-host team.example.org: that host and localhost are answered with 200; another host is refused with the list including the added one.
· --registry-root: GET / and POST /g/<id>/ with an unlisted Host are refused BEFORE the router lists, resolves or opens anything. The body does not reveal what the root holds. Loopback still reaches the router's own 404.
· Unit tests pin rmcp 3.4's matching (case-insensitive, brackets trimmed, a portless entry admits any port, an entry with a port admits only that one, a missing Host falls back to :authority, a malformed Host is a 400), the bounded echo, and the capped once-per-host log.
properties.name: A refused Host is told which host it used, which hosts are allowed, and the flag that admits it — on every HTTP surface
